text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3055556789 — elevated 5xx and p95 latency on /v1/generate across hosted-api; alerting customers seeing timeouts. Paging @maya (eng-oncall).

maya: on it, joining. any customer impact details yet?

samir: seeing a big spike in request size + KV cache misses from model-xyz leading to long tails. broad increase in batch queue length.

jess: autoscaling tried to kick but GPU warmup made a few requests timeout. I'm scaling a small dedicated pool for short-running fallbacks.

linus: quick check — are we routing to the fallback variant? smart-routing fallback rule didn't trigger for some regions.

maya: enabling manual fallback to model-xyz-v2 in us-west for now. posting command: `./rctl route set --from model-xyz --to model-xyz-v2 --region us-west --duration 15m`

taylor: applied temporary suppression for noisy alert group so paging stops while we mitigate: `opsctl silence --group=api_timeouts --for=30m`

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook hint: if fallback reduces errors, create canary for 10% traffic and monitor error_rate & p95_latency.

samir: after fallback, 5xx dropped ~70%, p95 improved from 5.4s -> 1.8s in us-west. other regions still noisy.

maya: good. I'm going to hand off incident at +40m to oncall-next. Jess, can you finish scaling and capture metrics?
jess: will do, scaling done, saving snapshot to tmp/grafana-snap-3055556789.json

linus: note for postmortem: alert noise was a problem — we had multiple redundant alerts firing at slightly different thresholds which drowned pager. Need consolidation.
samir: +1. Propose: consolidate to a single golden-signal alert per route: error_rate > 1% for 5m, p95_latency > 2s for 3m, queue_length > 50 for 2m.

maya: agree. Also want a dedicated post-incident Grafana dashboard for retros with drilldowns to traces/logs and per-customer breakdown. Will we track these panels?
taylor: I can own the dashboard build. basic panels to add: total req/s, error rate (5m), latency p50/p95, batch queue length, GPU util, per-model request distribution, top customers by error.

samir: adding query examples for Grafana (PromQL):
```
# request rate
sum(rate(redwood_request_total{route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (model)
# error rate
(sum(rate(redwood_request_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_request_total[5m]))) * 100
# p95 latency (histogram)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
# batch queue length
sum(redwood_batch_queue_length{pool!=""})
# GPU util
avg(redwood_gpu_utilization_percent) by (gpu)
```

jess: nice. for drilldowns, add panel links to traces: `/traces?query=route:%22/v1/generate%22%20and%20model:%22{{model}}%22` and to logs: `/logs?query=trace_id:{{trace_id}}`.

linus: also include a small panel showing recent config changes (git commits) and rollout events so we can correlate deploys.
maya: ok assign: @taylor dashboard build (include panels above + per-customer table), @samir alert tuning PR, @jess capture scaling timeline & snapshot, @linus add deploy correlator panel, I'll draft postmortem.
taylor: timeline — I'll spin up a dashboard branch and share link in #eng-sre by EOD.
samir: I'll open an alert PR with consolidated rules, will include temporary guardrails to avoid mass paging.
jess: saved autoscale logs and GPU warmup traces to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3055556789/

ops-runbook-bot: Handoff complete. Next oncall: @samir takes incident lead from +40m.
maya: handing off now, thanks team. scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 11:00 PT and will link the dashboard & artifacts.

linus: postmortem reminders: add remedials — increase KV cache size for model-xyz, add per-model warmup policy, tighten alert consolidation, and add golden-signal dashboard to runbook.

taylor: will include a short 'how to use this dashboard' panel with links to runbook snippets and escalation steps.

maya: perfect. closing pager for now :white_check_mark: — please keep adding notes to the dashboard branch.

samir: after-action note: consider adding an automated canary that reroutes 5% traffic to fallback for 10m after deploy to catch warmup regressions.

jess: +1 — also recommend a short-term alert that watches sudden increase in request size distribution (95th token length) so we can preempt KV thrash.

maya: added to todo list. thanks all.

(incident thread ended)
